notes: Task specifications are canonical here. Sprint Markdown files are generated. Sizes S/M/L are relative work units, not time estimates. Task completion never activates advisory lanes.

sprints.title: Repository discovery, scope and external prerequisites
sprints.goal: Inspect the actual repository before touching product code; establish verified boundaries and pursue data access early.
sprints.exit_gate: A repository inventory, explicit scope, provider evidence and an actionable unresolved-decision register exist. No live lane is enabled.
sprints.title_ar: اكتشاف المستودع وتثبيت النطاق والمتطلبات الخارجية

sprints.title: Repository foundation, security baseline and CI
sprints.goal: Create three runnable deployables and repeatable developer/CI environments before business features.
sprints.exit_gate: Go core, Go ingestion and Python worker boot locally; CI runs baseline checks; secrets and service identities are separated.

sprints.title: Canonical contracts, storage and event reliability
sprints.goal: Establish stable identities, versioned contracts and durable idempotent workflows.
sprints.exit_gate: Schema migrations, instrument/time rules and event contracts pass integration and duplicate-delivery tests.

sprints.title: US and EGX ingestion and point-in-time data quality
sprints.goal: Build independent adapters and prevent stale, invalid or unlicensed data from feeding actionable recommendations.
sprints.exit_gate: Synthetic adapters pass all gates; each real feed has separately recorded coverage, entitlements and validation evidence.

sprints.title: Portfolio ledger, executions and reconciliation
sprints.goal: Build the authoritative financial state before personalized recommendations or goal optimization.
sprints.exit_gate: Account-scoped cash, positions and manual fills reconcile; duplicate and concurrent events cannot create money or double-spend available cash.

sprints.title: Deterministic policy kernel and recommendation lifecycle
sprints.goal: Enforce all financial and human-only invariants before a recommendation can become actionable.
sprints.exit_gate: Live and replay use the same risk implementation; stale/unfunded/unauthorized advice is rejected; pausing entries preserves position monitoring.

sprints.title: Point-in-time simulator, baselines and evaluation gates
sprints.goal: Build realistic replay and preregister evaluation criteria before tuning strategies or prompts.
sprints.exit_gate: Leakage tests, deterministic baselines and realistic execution assumptions are documented; no result is treated as evidence of guaranteed returns.

sprints.title: Financial statements, stock history and evidence intelligence
sprints.goal: Make financial-statement and historical-behavior assessments mandatory inputs rather than optional summaries.
sprints.exit_gate: Evidence-backed assessments exist with publication timing and accounting context; missing material inputs block new entries.

sprints.title: Hierarchical advisory committee and model evaluation
sprints.goal: Implement the agreed advisory roles with bounded, evidence-first workflows and independent control checks.
sprints.exit_gate: Committee outputs are structured and auditable; no model output can mutate financial state or bypass policy.

sprints.title: Swing strategy lanes and position monitoring
sprints.goal: Implement and evaluate distinct EGX and US swing strategies without changing the shared safety layer.
sprints.exit_gate: Both swing lanes have reproducible evaluation artifacts; each remains disabled until its independent activation gates pass.

sprints.title: Telegram, human workflow and paper operations
sprints.goal: Deliver transparent actionable/nonactionable messages and capture human execution without sending broker commands.
sprints.exit_gate: Authenticated Telegram interactions, expiry, delivery ambiguity and paper-versus-actual separation pass end-to-end tests.

sprints.title: Trading Intelligence Division and intraday lanes
sprints.goal: Add the five trading specialists and feasible intraday strategies without introducing scalping or automated orders.
sprints.exit_gate: Intraday decisions respect real feeds, human latency, account eligibility and session cutoffs; EGX and US are evaluated separately.

sprints.title: Goals, feasibility and portfolio-level progress
sprints.goal: Add goal-aware planning that cannot increase approved risk to chase a deadline.
sprints.exit_gate: Goals are versioned, evidence-based and separated from forecasts; cash flows and actual performance are correctly attributed.

sprints.title: Dashboard, audit exploration and operating controls
sprints.goal: Make the system operable and understandable without bypassing Go policy or Telegram safeguards.
sprints.exit_gate: Owner can inspect actual state, evidence, goals, incidents and costs; access and mode separation are tested.

sprints.title: Production deployment, resilience and release engineering
sprints.goal: Deploy safely and prove recovery under the chosen workload; hardening builds on controls already present since S01.
sprints.exit_gate: Infrastructure, signed artifacts, migration strategy, backup restore and load/chaos tests pass independently reviewed release gates.

sprints.title: Independent lane activation and post-release evaluation
sprints.goal: Move each market/strategy through forward-paper and human-reviewed limited advisory gates, never from a calendar deadline.
sprints.exit_gate: Each lane has a recorded GO or NO_GO; actual execution remains human-only; continuing evaluation and disable procedures are operational.
sprints.title_ar: تفعيل كل سوق واستراتيجية بشكل مستقل

sprints.title: Optional OpenClaw read-only interface
sprints.goal: Add an optional explanation interface only after core operation is established and explicitly authorized.
sprints.exit_gate: Removing or compromising the optional assistant cannot submit orders, change risk, mutate portfolio state or stop official notifications.

tasks.title: Inspect the actual repository and reconcile this plan
tasks.scope: Inspect AGENTS instructions, Git branch/HEAD, dirty files, existing code, docs, CI and sibling services. This package has not inspected the user’s repository. Map proposed paths onto reality without moving or deleting existing work.
acceptance_criteria: Record exact repository root, HEAD, branch and working-tree state in a dated session handoff.
List existing implementations and conflicts; reuse verified work and create an ADR for material deviations.
Do not mark implementation tasks complete solely because files or prior chat claims exist.
Reconcile any existing ADR-011 before assigning or replacing its identifier.
validation: Capture read-only Git inventory and discovered test commands.
Run the documentation validator; distinguish baseline tool tests from product tests.

tasks.title: Confirm product boundaries, users and operating modes
tasks.scope: Convert approved scope into testable boundaries: private single-owner pilot, four independent market/strategy lanes, human-only execution, goal-aware risk constraints and later optional assistant integration.
acceptance_criteria: Map all requirements in REQUIREMENTS_TRACEABILITY.md.
Separate product approval from implementation/release approval.
Define operating modes OFFLINE_REPLAY, SHADOW, PAPER and LIVE_ADVISORY; production defaults disabled.
Keep broker order APIs, leverage, short selling, options and scalping outside the baseline.
validation: Review scope against SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md and detect conflicting statements.

tasks.title: Qualify market-data vendors and document licensing
tasks.scope: Start US and EGX procurement independently. Request sample payloads, exchange coverage, timestamps, corrections, historical depth, entitlements, retention and non-display/derived-data/LLM-use permissions. Marketing pages are not contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Produce one due-diligence record per candidate; label UNKNOWN rather than assume coverage.
Distinguish consolidated US coverage from a single venue; identify auction, quote/trade conditions and halt support.
Document EGX intraday history, same-session eligibility support, bid/ask coverage and actual L2 availability.
Record cost and technical evidence without storing credentials; a missing vendor does not block synthetic core development.
validation: Parse a legitimately obtained sample or mark the sample gate BLOCKED.
Verify license scope with written provider evidence before any licensed production use.

tasks.title: Define account, settlement and market-rule research
tasks.scope: Identify intended brokers and account types, then document how effective-dated exchange and broker rules will be sourced. Do not hard-code today’s rules or assume the same eligibility across EGX and US.
acceptance_criteria: Define unknown account types and settlement capabilities as explicit activation blockers.
Identify authoritative sources for sessions, holidays, halts, eligibility, fees and taxes; record verification owner and expiry.
Determine whether the pilot remains private and whether commercial advisory review is required.
Specify manual statements/imports or optional read-only account access; never request trading credentials.
validation: Review one EGX and one US hypothetical account capability matrix without presenting it as verified broker behavior.

tasks.title: Pin compatible toolchains and estimate workload/cost
tasks.scope: Run a compatibility spike for the chosen Go/Python/PostgreSQL/NATS libraries and migration tooling. Establish a measured load profile and an initial infrastructure/LLM/data budget, not a promised latency or return.
acceptance_criteria: Choose supported stable versions after checking official documentation; pin modules, uv lockfile and container digests.
Document symbol count, feed event rate, concurrency, analysis budget and expected retention.
Select authentication provider and deployment approach through D-05/D-06; no custom token cryptography.
Record costs as dated estimates with source and currency; no production resources are created without approval.
validation: Build and connect a disposable Go and Python client to PostgreSQL and JetStream.
Verify the selected LangGraph checkpointer can persist/resume on the pinned versions.

tasks.title: Establish task ownership, review and session continuity
tasks.scope: Adopt the supplied planning protocol and integrate its validator in repository automation. Define who reviews high-risk changes and how multiple agents coordinate.
acceptance_criteria: Root AGENTS.md references this docs pack without erasing existing instructions.
Task definitions live in task_catalog.json; execution status lives only in project_state.json.
Every new session verifies Git state and existing claims before claiming a task.
Require evidence-backed handoffs; never reset in-progress work after context loss.
validation: Exercise claim/block/review/done transitions on a disposable copy.
Validate the dependency graph and generated sprint documents.

tasks.title: Create reconciled module boundaries and build commands
tasks.scope: Create or adapt the monorepo skeleton. Keep Go business modules inside a single Go module initially; create one Python research package and generated-contract locations.
acceptance_criteria: Three independent entrypoints exist: platform-core, market-ingestion and research-worker.
Core domain code has no framework or network dependencies.
Document build/test commands and supported toolchains.
Do not create a service per advisory role.
validation: Build both Go binaries and import the Python package in CI.
Check dependency direction and no import from Go domain into adapters.

tasks.title: Create local containers and deterministic fixtures
tasks.scope: Define Compose services for app entrypoints, PostgreSQL and NATS; use synthetic data and an approved local S3 substitute or fixture adapter. Avoid unlicensed datasets in Git.
acceptance_criteria: One documented command starts dependencies with persistent development volumes and health checks.
Containers run as non-root where feasible; secrets are supplied outside tracked files.
Offline fixtures run without provider or LLM credentials.
Teardown is non-destructive by default; removing volumes is explicit.
validation: Smoke-test clean startup, shutdown and restart with persisted fixtures.
Verify no live advisory delivery occurs in development defaults.

tasks.title: Implement CI baseline and documentation drift checks
tasks.scope: Add incremental build/lint/test jobs and validate plan integrity, schemas and generated files. Use least-privilege workflow permissions and no secrets for untrusted pull requests.
acceptance_criteria: Go format/vet/race tests and Python lint/type/unit tests run with pinned tooling.
Dependency/secret scans are enabled; explicit reviewed waivers have owners and expiry.
planctl validate and render --check run on docs changes.
CI reports test counts and unrun integration suites honestly.
validation: Introduce intentional test, schema and docs drift failures in an isolated branch and confirm failure.

tasks.title: Introduce identity, authorization and service credentials
tasks.scope: Implement the approved identity approach with owner/reviewer/read-only roles and scoped service credentials. The private pilot is one owner, but every financial record is account-scoped.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated access to portfolio and research administration is denied.
Issuer/audience/expiry, CSRF or token handling and service-to-service authorization are tested for the chosen auth method.
DB roles separate core writes, ingestion writes and research writes; no shared superuser.
Credentials are not available to LLM tools or logs.
validation: Negative auth tests, cross-account identifier tests and expired-token tests.

tasks.title: Add observability and safe worker lifecycle
tasks.scope: Instrument startup, health, traces and structured logs; enforce context cancellation, bounded worker pools, retry budgets and graceful shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: Trace/correlation IDs survive HTTP and NATS boundaries.
Liveness differs from readiness; dependency outage changes readiness without leaking secrets.
Logs exclude bot tokens, account secrets and full licensed document content.
Cancellation drains or requeues work and never loses a financial transaction.
validation: Kill/restart worker during a synthetic job and inspect its recovery.
Verify bounded concurrency under a slow-provider fixture.

tasks.title: Create architecture-level threat and no-execution tests
tasks.scope: Establish a maintained threat model and architectural guardrails covering human-only execution, data poisoning, prompt injection, SSRF, credentials and unauthorized goal changes.
acceptance_criteria: No broker order placement/cancel/amend capability exists in API contracts or service permissions.
Untrusted document fetches have allowlists, size limits and internal-network protection.
Production-risk settings cannot be changed by agents.
Negative tests are mandatory gates rather than documentation-only promises.
validation: Test forbidden broker endpoints, private-network URLs and malicious document instructions.

tasks.title: Implement OpenAPI and event-schema ownership
tasks.scope: Turn CONTRACTS.md into executable OpenAPI and versioned JSON Schemas. Generate or validate Go and Python payload types from the same contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Decimal values cross service boundaries as strings; timestamps are UTC RFC3339.
Envelope contains event/causation/correlation IDs, schema version and producer build.
Unknown enum values and breaking schema changes fail compatibility tests.
Execution-report endpoints record past human fills; no order-submission endpoint exists.
validation: Cross-language round-trip golden fixtures and invalid-payload tests.

tasks.title: Create database migrations, owners and index conventions
tasks.scope: Create core, market, research and audit schemas with least-privilege roles, migration locking, numeric precision choices and ownership boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh database migration and prior-version upgrade both succeed.
Foreign keys, uniqueness, account ownership and positive quantity checks are enforced where applicable.
Money uses exact numeric representation and documented rounding.
Migration rollout is expand/contract; irreversible data changes are not described as app rollback.
validation: Test migration from empty and previous fixture DB; test constraints with invalid records.

tasks.title: Build instrument master and effective-dated market rules
tasks.scope: Use stable instrument IDs independent of ticker changes; version venues, currencies, calendars, settlement/eligibility and corporate-action mappings.
acceptance_criteria: Ticker reuse, rename, dual listings, delistings and historical memberships have explicit identities.
US and Egyptian daylight-saving/session behavior use verified IANA zones and exchange calendars, not fixed UTC offsets.
Rule applicability is evaluated as of trade/event date and broker capability.
Unknown critical eligibility blocks the affected lane.
validation: Holiday, half-day, DST, ticker-reuse and missing-rule fixtures.

tasks.title: Implement outbox, inbox and replay-safe consumers
tasks.scope: Add transactional outbox for domain writes, durable consumers, inbox identities and controlled retries. Treat transport and business idempotency as different boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Domain row and outbox row commit atomically.
Crash after processing and before ACK cannot duplicate a ledger effect or recommendation.
Poison messages are quarantined after a bounded retry policy with replay tooling.
Consumer ordering/aggregate versions and inbox retention are explicitly documented.
validation: Crash-window tests before/after DB commit, publish acknowledgment and consumer acknowledgment.
Replay the same batch repeatedly and verify stable business-state counts.

tasks.title: Implement durable schedules, leases and workload isolation
tasks.scope: Add scheduled job records keyed by job, market session and due time; use leased claims with fencing for duplicate runners. Separate live research from batch/replay consumers.
acceptance_criteria: Two scheduler instances cannot produce two logical jobs for one slot.
Expired owner cannot commit after lease takeover.
A missed run has an explicit catch-up/skip policy.
Replay subjects and storage cannot emit production Telegram effects.
validation: Concurrent scheduler, clock-skew, lease-expiry and stale-owner tests.

tasks.title: Persist raw evidence and dataset manifests
tasks.scope: Persist immutable source objects, metadata, hashes, entitlements and versioned Parquet manifests. Large documents travel by references, not by event payload.
acceptance_criteria: Object checksum and source identity are stored with publication and ingestion times.
Corrections create linked versions rather than silently replacing historical evidence.
Retention/encryption/access reflect the provider contract.
A manifest deterministically identifies input files and adjustment versions.
validation: Corrupt-object, missing-object and corrected-document fixtures.

tasks.title: Define adapters and a synthetic/replay feed
tasks.scope: Create a provider-neutral adapter interface for bars, quotes, trades, statuses and corporate actions. Declare capabilities explicitly rather than assuming identical feeds.
acceptance_criteria: Each capability specifies precision, timing, venue coverage and delay status.
Synthetic feeds include late, out-of-order, duplicate and corrected records.
Reconnect/backpressure policy is bounded and observable.
Only one active subscription owner exists per provider partition.
validation: Adapter conformance suite and subscription takeover/fencing tests.

tasks.title: Implement selected US feed adapter
tasks.scope: Implement the licensed US provider selected by D-01; retain venue provenance and distinguish quotes, trades, auctions and corrections.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter passes shared conformance suite using permitted samples.
Single-venue data is never labeled consolidated.
Historical and streaming symbols map to the same instrument master.
Production entitlement remains disabled until provider evidence is approved.
validation: Provider sandbox/read-only integration tests and quota/reconnect tests.

tasks.title: Implement selected EGX feed adapter
tasks.scope: Implement EGID or another contractually approved EGX source; document actual timing, historical intervals, book coverage and status messages without assuming L2.
acceptance_criteria: Arabic/English identifiers map without duplicating instruments.
Feed delay and trading-status/eligibility gaps are visible.
Missing L2 disables L2 strategies but does not fabricate book data.
Licensed history and current data share adjustment/version semantics.
validation: Provider conformance, disconnect and out-of-session fixtures; real sample validation when access exists.

tasks.title: Build normalization, quality scoring and freshness gates
tasks.scope: Validate timestamps, clock drift, crossed/invalid quotes, duplicate trades, gaps and schema drift; expose quality reasons and per-strategy freshness requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Use event, publication, receipt and decision timestamps distinctly.
Unknown delay or stale critical data blocks new-entry qualification.
Missing intervals are not forward-filled as traded volume.
Data resumes only after bounded recovery checks; existing position monitoring continues in degraded mode.
validation: Table-driven quality tests, stale-feed alarm and recovery hysteresis tests.

tasks.title: Create historical backfill and corporate-action versions
tasks.scope: Backfill permitted history with resumable checkpoints and correction provenance; maintain raw prices, split-adjusted features and total-return series as distinct products.
acceptance_criteria: Dividend, split, rights issue and symbol-change fixtures are versioned and reproducible.
Raw executable prices are not confused with total-return adjusted prices.
Point-in-time universe includes delisted instruments where data permits.
Historical gaps are declared and propagate to eligibility.
validation: Interrupted backfill resume, correction replay and manifest checksum tests.

tasks.title: Measure feed readiness per market and capability
tasks.scope: Create separate readiness reports for EGX and US and for EOD, intraday quotes/trades and optional L2. One blocked provider must not falsely qualify the other. Evaluate available feeds and record NO_GO for unavailable feeds; completion of this review never represents an unfinished adapter as implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Report measured gap rates, delay distribution, timestamp quality and coverage against preregistered thresholds.
Maintain independent approval records; aggregate task completion is not live-lane activation.
Perform source spot checks and document entitlement expiry.
A missing provider leaves that market blocked, with independent-ready work continuing by approved task split if needed.
validation: Run a complete sample trading session replay with injected outage.

tasks.title: Implement ledger and exact monetary arithmetic
tasks.scope: Implement an immutable balanced ledger per currency with explicit accounts for cash, settlement, fees, dividends and adjustments; separate security quantity subledger where appropriate.
acceptance_criteria: Posted journals balance by currency; float conversion cannot silently change money.
Corrections use reversing/replacement entries with causal links.
An external event key cannot post twice.
Rebuild derived balances from journal entries and compare to projections.
validation: Property tests for balance/conservation; retry and rollback tests.

tasks.title: Record human executions and partial fills
tasks.scope: Accept actual fills reported by the owner or imported from statements. Treat recommendation acknowledgment, simulated fill and actual execution as different records.
acceptance_criteria: Capture account, instrument, side, quantity, price, fees, currency, occurred time and provenance.
Execution can be linked to a recommendation or independently entered; neither case sends an order.
Partial fills, corrections and multiple fee lines preserve immutable accounting.
Unauthorized and duplicate reports do not alter balances.
validation: Concurrent duplicate submission, incorrect-account and partial-fill tests.

tasks.title: Implement settlement, currency and buying-power views
tasks.scope: Derive settled/unsettled balances and broker-capability-aware cash availability. Maintain actual FX conversions separately from reporting currency marks.
acceptance_criteria: No borrowing or unapproved cross-account cash pooling.
Effective-dated rules determine when cash can fund the intended operation.
FX source/time and conversion fees are visible; stale FX blocks affected personalized sizing.
Deposits and withdrawals are not classified as trading profit.
validation: Settlement holiday/DST, insufficient-cash, multicurrency and deposit attribution fixtures.

tasks.title: Apply corporate actions to actual positions
tasks.scope: Apply effective-dated splits, cash distributions and supported rights events to the ledger/quantity records with entitlement/payable dates and audit links.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated events cannot double-credit a dividend or split.
Ex-date receivables differ from paid cash.
Raw execution history remains unchanged by chart adjustments.
Unsupported actions freeze affected sizing until manually reconciled, not silently approximated.
validation: Split, dividend, reversal and unsupported-rights fixtures.

tasks.title: Add statement import and reconciliation gates
tasks.scope: Provide validated statement/CSV import or approved read-only adapter; maintain import provenance, duplicate checks and discrepancy review.
acceptance_criteria: A preview shows changes before posting and has account-scoped authorization.
Unknown positions, unexplained balances and stale reconciliation have explicit states.
Unreconciled portfolio blocks new personalized entries but not existing-position alerts.
Raw files are protected; no broker trading permission is requested.
validation: Duplicate import, invalid encoding, malicious spreadsheet-formula text and discrepancy tests.

tasks.title: Implement atomic capital reservations and race tests
tasks.scope: Reserve advisory buying-power/risk budget for valid proposals to prevent mutually incompatible recommendations. Reservations are internal budgeting, never broker orders.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent EGX/US or intraday/swing requests cannot allocate the same account cash twice.
Expiry releases only the reservation; uncertain actual fills trigger reconciliation rather than assumed release.
One account/instrument position owner strategy is enforced in the initial release.
All advisory budgets remain bounded by confirmed actual balances.
validation: PostgreSQL parallel transaction tests for oversubscription, expiry and delayed fill reporting.

tasks.title: Implement shared policy kernel and versioned risk configs
tasks.scope: Create a pure Go policy package plus a batch command usable by Python simulations. Version limits, broker/market rules and rounding semantics.
acceptance_criteria: No LLM/network access in policy evaluation.
Missing approved limits fail closed; historical example percentages are not defaults.
Inputs include portfolio revision, data snapshot, strategy and policy versions.
Decision returns structured pass/fail reasons and executable-size proposal, not an order.
validation: Golden vectors compare Go API and batch runner results exactly for monetary outputs.

tasks.title: Implement exposure, liquidity and loss gates
tasks.scope: Apply cash, position, sector, correlated-risk, liquidity and daily/drawdown constraints; include costs and gap-aware scenario limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Entry sizing respects all caps and min lot/tick constraints.
Expected stop loss is explicitly not a guaranteed maximum loss.
Missing bid/ask or other strategy-required capability blocks that strategy.
SELL/REDUCE proposals cannot exceed confirmed long holdings.
validation: Boundary, rounding, missing-data, gap and cross-strategy exposure tests.

tasks.title: Implement immutable recommendation revisions
tasks.scope: Create recommendation revision records with entry range, invalidation, horizon, expiry, evidence and policy results. Keep delivery/response/fills in separate state machines.
acceptance_criteria: Updating a recommendation appends a revision and explicitly supersedes the old one.
Watchlist/insufficient-data decisions cannot be rendered as actionable buys.
Acknowledgment never marks execution; expiry does not close a real position.
Idempotent candidate/version keys prevent duplicate logical advice.
validation: State transition, supersession, race and duplicate recommendation tests.

tasks.title: Close the research-to-delivery race
tasks.scope: Revalidate price, account revision, policy, market status and report validity immediately before committing an actionable recommendation and again before delivery where needed.
acceptance_criteria: A material new filing invalidates cached qualifying research.
Stale price or portfolio changes during committee work force recompute or rejection.
Final allocation and risk checks occur atomically for account-scoped budgets.
Expired advice cannot be revived by a delayed worker.
validation: Concurrent fill during analysis, delayed publish and invalidated-report integration tests.

tasks.title: Build entry pause, loss review and degraded-mode behavior
tasks.scope: Implement scoped entry pause/global safe mode with audited human override rules. Keep critical monitoring and exit/reconciliation prompts operating where data permits.
acceptance_criteria: Paused entries cannot be bypassed by chief agent, goal engine or Telegram button.
Existing positions remain tracked and no automatic exit is implied.
Stale market data is displayed explicitly in risk alerts.
Resuming entries requires defined checks, authorized approval and a new audit event.
validation: Provider outage, loss-threshold, paused-entry and unauthorized-resume tests.

tasks.title: Run financial invariant and adversarial integration suite
tasks.scope: Create a mandatory adversarial suite spanning contracts, events, ledger and recommendation state; review this kernel independently before strategy integration.
acceptance_criteria: No double-posting or duplicate allocation under injected failures.
No route can create broker execution or change risk from an LLM payload.
Four-lane identifiers and budgets remain distinct.
Independent review records exact commit, test commands/results and unresolved limits.
validation: Run race/property/integration suites and contract-negative cases against PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Build point-in-time dataset loader
tasks.scope: Load only the information available at each historical decision time, including filings, revisions, instrument universe and macro vintages.
acceptance_criteria: Economic period-end is never used as publication time.
Restatements and future-adjusted data cannot leak into earlier decisions.
Training, validation and holdout datasets have immutable manifests.
Unavailable history is explicitly excluded or marked, never reconstructed with future knowledge.
validation: Inject future facts and verify rejection; test delisted/ticker-reused instruments.

tasks.title: Implement event-driven fill and human-latency simulator
tasks.scope: Simulate decision time, alert delay, human response and feasible fills separately. Reuse policy-eval and market/account rules.
acceptance_criteria: Include bid/ask spread, slippage, fees, partial/non-fills, halts and limit states.
Bar-only tests use conservative ambiguity handling for stop/target in the same bar.
Intraday cutoff cannot guarantee an exit during a halt; carry residual exposure explicitly.
Avoid assuming fills at the signal bar close or prices before the user could act.
validation: Golden scenarios for gaps, halt, delayed human, invalid order size and same-bar ambiguity.

tasks.title: Establish simple baseline strategies and metrics
tasks.scope: Implement approved simple baselines, benchmark currency/return conventions and performance measurement independent of the LLM committee.
acceptance_criteria: Report net return, drawdown, exposure, turnover, expectancy and uncertainty.
Include costs, idle cash, FX and withdrawals/deposits consistently.
Use suitable EGX/US benchmark definitions without assuming licensed total-return series availability.
Publish negative results and no-trade intervals.
validation: Compare against hand-calculated small examples and a no-trade portfolio.

tasks.title: Preregister holdouts, thresholds and trial accounting
tasks.scope: Define walk-forward splits, purging/embargo where horizons overlap, experiment tracking and release thresholds before strategy selection.
acceptance_criteria: Every tested strategy/prompt/model configuration is counted, not only winners.
Sample-size and uncertainty criteria are approved per lane before unblinding holdouts.
No arbitrary win-rate number is presented as a release guarantee.
Threshold changes after results require a new experiment and new untouched evaluation data.
validation: Validate manifest split overlap, embargo rules and rejected retrospective threshold edits.

tasks.title: Build replay determinism and live-feature parity tests
tasks.scope: Run the same recorded events through live and replay feature/policy paths; record intentional numeric tolerances only for statistical outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Policy outcomes and monetary values match exactly.
Indicator warmup, missing data and session reset rules match across execution modes.
No replay pipeline can send a production message.
Clock source and randomized seeds are controlled and recorded.
validation: Byte/digest checks for deterministic outputs and approved numeric tolerance tests.

tasks.title: Add paper ledger and evaluation reports
tasks.scope: Persist simulated transactions in an isolated accounting namespace and produce reproducible run reports for all four lanes.
acceptance_criteria: Paper and actual cash/positions are impossible to mix by account/mode identifiers and permissions.
Report input manifest, commit, strategy, policy, cost model and assumptions.
Separate recommendation quality from assumed fill performance.
Reports identify missing prerequisites and never silently promote a lane.
validation: Isolation tests and reproducibility check from report manifest.

tasks.title: Ingest official financial filings and preserve provenance
tasks.scope: Implement SEC structured filings and contractually accessible EGX/issuer documents. Preserve original documents, publication timestamps, amendments and hashes.
acceptance_criteria: Each filing records entity, period, publication time, accounting framework, currency and consolidation scope.
Quarterly, annual and year-to-date contexts are not conflated.
Amended filings remain linked to originals without rewriting earlier knowledge.
HTML/XBRL/PDF extraction uses a safe pipeline; OCR is fallback only and is flagged.
validation: SEC fixture and permitted EGX document extraction tests with original-source references.

tasks.title: Extract and reconcile financial facts
tasks.scope: Extract statements, notes and auditor findings into typed facts; derive ratios only from compatible contexts and verified arithmetic.
acceptance_criteria: Balance sheet, cash-flow and unit checks flag inconsistent extraction.
Distinguish reported vs derived values and retain note/page/section references.
Bank and nonfinancial-company templates avoid inappropriate identical ratios.
Quality warnings, auditor issues and one-off gains are available to the committee.
validation: Hand-reviewed golden documents, numeric reconciliation and incorrect-unit cases.

tasks.title: Build financial-health and historical-behavior assessments
tasks.scope: Produce reusable financial health and stock-history reports including returns, volatility, drawdowns, liquidity and benchmark-relative behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Use five years of financials and five-to-ten years of price history as targets when available, not invented minimum history.
Short-history instruments expose limitations and pass only explicitly approved eligibility rules.
Raw/adjusted series choices are documented for each metric.
Assessments have validity conditions and explicit invalidation on material changes.
validation: New listing, missing quarters, split/dividend and restatement assessment tests.

tasks.title: Build macro, news and event intelligence pipeline
tasks.scope: Ingest official Fed/economic/central-bank sources and licensed news; deduplicate stories and normalize catalysts with event, expected, published and received times.
acceptance_criteria: US and Egyptian macro/currency context remain distinct and can affect both markets.
Rumors, commentary and official disclosures have separate evidence classes.
Repeated syndication is not counted as independent corroboration.
Consensus expectations and revisions are used only with licensed point-in-time sources.
validation: Duplicate-news, rumor-to-confirmation, revised macro and future-event cases.

tasks.title: Implement evidence search and untrusted-content controls
tasks.scope: Build evidence retrieval using metadata/full-text first; add semantic retrieval only on a measured need. Treat source documents as data, not agent instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Every material claim resolves to an accessible evidence ID and exact context.
Unsupported claims and fabricated citations fail validation.
Tool allowlists block code execution, secret access and arbitrary URL fetch from retrieved text.
LLM-use rights and redaction are checked before sending documents to a provider.
validation: Prompt-injection corpus, citation mismatch and forbidden-exfiltration tests.

tasks.title: Evaluate extraction quality and mandatory evidence gates
tasks.scope: Create a reviewed evaluation corpus for both markets with materiality-aware accuracy and missing-data behavior.
acceptance_criteria: No actionable new entry lacks current financial-health and historical-behavior assessments.
Numbers, units and timing have independently checked samples.
Material ambiguity yields INSUFFICIENT_DATA rather than guessed values.
Record dataset licenses, reviewer, commit and failure cases.
validation: Run extraction/claim validation benchmarks and adversarial missing-input tests.

tasks.title: Implement role contracts and conditional routing
tasks.scope: Implement the eighteen research/control roles as logical modules, with five trading specialists activated later only when relevant. Do not launch every role on every tick.
acceptance_criteria: Role-to-data/capability requirements and cache invalidation are executable.
Financial, historical, evidence and risk gates are mandatory for new entries.
Logical role count is not represented as independent statistical evidence.
Deterministic calculations remain outside LLM-generated arithmetic.
validation: Route selection and missing-capability tests across all four lanes.

tasks.title: Implement independent analysis, challenge and synthesis
tasks.scope: Run independent first-pass assessments, bounded evidence-based challenge and synthesis. Preserve dissent and reasons to abstain.
acceptance_criteria: First-pass outputs are isolated from other roles’ conclusions.
Debate has bounded rounds, tokens, concurrency and timeout.
Chair cannot override deterministic veto or manufacture numerical success probabilities.
Final assessment lists evidence, counterarguments, unknowns and invalidation conditions.
validation: Conflicting-evidence, empty-consensus and majority-wrong fixtures.

tasks.title: Add durable checkpoints and safe retries
tasks.scope: Persist LangGraph state with a production checkpointer and versioned model/prompt/tool configuration. Reconcile uncertain tool outcomes before retrying consequential effects.
acceptance_criteria: Resume is tied to compatible workflow/config versions.
Retries do not create duplicate reports or completed jobs.
LLM-provider outage cannot bypass required research or stop deterministic position monitoring.
No secrets, uncontrolled tools or broker capabilities enter graph state.
validation: Crash/resume before and after model call and report persistence; incompatible-version recovery.

tasks.title: Implement bounded caching, triggers and cost budgets
tasks.scope: Cache company/sector research by evidence/config hash and trigger refresh only when material inputs change. Isolate live versus batch quotas.
acceptance_criteria: TTL alone is insufficient when a material disclosure arrives; invalidate by event.
Cache keys contain model/prompt/data/strategy versions and as-of time.
Cost budget exhaustion yields defer/insufficient-data rather than silent weaker advice.
Per-candidate token/time/cost records support operational analysis.
validation: Material-news invalidation, budget exhaustion and concurrent refresh tests.

tasks.title: Build committee evaluation and ablation suite
tasks.scope: Compare committee-assisted strategies to deterministic baselines and reduced-role variants without contaminating holdouts.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluate factuality, citation support, abstention, calibration where justified and incremental decision value.
Historical LLM pretraining knowledge is treated as possible leakage; historical outputs are not called leakage-free.
Forward shadow/paper evaluation is required for claims affected by model knowledge leakage.
Do not tune prompts on the final holdout.
validation: Run red-team, ablation, cost-per-accepted-assessment and stability evaluation.

tasks.title: Integrate committee results through the Go decision gate
tasks.scope: Consume versioned research assessments and finalize only through Go policy checks and fresh portfolio/data snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed/unsubstantiated assessment is quarantined.
Financial and historical inputs remain mandatory even for a high model score.
Decision stores assessment version, policy version and fresh revalidation result.
A completed graph alone cannot emit official actionable Telegram advice.
validation: End-to-end synthetic assessment-to-recommendation tests with veto and stale-input scenarios.

tasks.title: Specify two versioned swing configurations
tasks.scope: Define entry, exit, time exit, catalyst, earnings exposure and liquidity logic separately for EGX_SWING and US_SWING.
acceptance_criteria: Rules are executable and have evidence-backed rationale, not a vague composite score.
No forced minimum trade count or goal-driven risk increase.
Benchmarks, costs, horizon and instrument eligibility are fixed before evaluation.
Strategy config is immutable and approval-controlled.
validation: Schema and boundary tests for both strategy configurations.

tasks.title: Implement swing screening and candidate ranking
tasks.scope: Implement cheap deterministic screening followed by cached/deep research for qualifying candidates; rank opportunities after liquidity and cost constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Same input manifest/config produces stable candidate ordering.
A high score cannot bypass missing financial evidence.
Daily-bar finalization respects market calendar and late corrections.
No recommendation is inferred from an incomplete current-session bar unless explicitly designed and tested.
validation: Screening golden fixtures, repeated event and late-bar correction tests.

tasks.title: Implement swing lifecycle and event-driven re-evaluation
tasks.scope: Monitor actual positions for invalidation, time exit, earnings/catalysts and portfolio risk changes; generate human-action alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Exit alerts reference confirmed holdings and latest reliable data.
Price/goal changes never automatically extend the strategy horizon.
Stop and target prices are not represented as guaranteed fills.
Monitoring continues if new entries are paused.
validation: Gap, earnings, time-exit, stale-position and entry-pause tests.

tasks.title: Evaluate US swing against preregistered gates
tasks.scope: Run US_SWING training/validation and sealed holdout with licensed data, complete costs and human latency assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Publish wins, losses, no-trade intervals, sample adequacy and uncertainty.
Compare against baseline and reduced-agent configurations.
Record data coverage shortcomings and remaining activation blockers.
Do not alter thresholds after inspecting results.
validation: Re-run from immutable manifest and verify report checksums.

tasks.title: Evaluate EGX swing against preregistered gates
tasks.scope: Run EGX_SWING with verified EGX eligibility, costs, liquidity and price-limit assumptions; avoid importing US execution assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Low-liquidity non-fill and exit constraints are represented.
Currency/benchmark conventions are explicit.
Limited historical coverage cannot be hidden by pooled US results.
Lane remains blocked if data or evidence is inadequate.
validation: Re-run EGX-specific gap/limit/holiday scenarios and holdout report.

tasks.title: Create swing research release and rollback manifest
tasks.scope: Freeze accepted configs or document rejection; prepare shadow-mode promotion without enabling real actionable advice. Assemble only the available lane evidence; missing evaluation produces a lane-specific NO_GO, not a cross-market implementation barrier.
acceptance_criteria: Release manifest pins code, data, prompt/model, fees and policy versions.
Rejected strategy has a documented reason and remains disabled.
Rollback restores compatible software/config, not historical executed trades.
Per-lane evidence is separate; one lane can proceed via a documented task split if the other is blocked.
validation: Replay release manifest on a clean environment and exercise disable/restore.

tasks.title: Register bot identities and secure incoming updates
tasks.scope: Configure bot/webhook or approved polling mode, allowed user/chat identities and signed/opaque short-lived action references.
acceptance_criteria: Verify webhook secret header when using webhooks; deduplicate updates.
Only paired authorized Telegram identities may access account information.
Callback data never acts as authorization by itself.
Bot token is redacted and rotatable with an incident runbook.
validation: Forged webhook, replay, wrong-chat and expired-action tests.

tasks.title: Implement notification outbox and ambiguous delivery handling
tasks.scope: Persist delivery attempts and Telegram message identifiers. Distinguish unique logical recommendations from possibly duplicated external messages after timeout.
acceptance_criteria: Use PENDING/SENDING/SENT/UNKNOWN/FAILED states with bounded retries and rate-limit handling.
Do not claim end-to-end exactly-once delivery; timeout after send may be ambiguous.
Expose recommendation ID/revision in each message to identify repeats.
Expired entries are not resent as fresh actionable advice.
validation: Timeout before/after remote acceptance, retry-after and process-crash tests.

tasks.title: Create advice, alert and status message templates
tasks.scope: Render Arabic-first Telegram messages with instrument/venue, strategy, data time, entry range, invalidation, size cap, expiry, evidence and risk reasons.
acceptance_criteria: PAPER, SHADOW and LIVE_ADVISORY labels cannot be confused.
Watchlist/insufficient-data/exit alerts have different templates.
No unsupported probability or guaranteed target appears.
A stale recommendation is visibly expired and action links are disabled server-side.
validation: Golden-message tests including Arabic/English symbols, escaping and length splitting.

tasks.title: Implement human availability and actual-fill workflow
tasks.scope: Provide acknowledge, ignore, watch and record-execution interactions; collect actual fill details and revalidate context without submitting an order.
acceptance_criteria: Record execution requires price, quantity, account and actual timestamp.
Acknowledgment is not a fill and does not debit the ledger.
User-unavailable mode suppresses time-critical new entries but not risk monitoring.
Late or partial execution triggers reconciliation and risk refresh.
validation: Full message-to-manual-fill and wrong-account scenarios; prove no order network call occurs.

tasks.title: Operate shadow/paper runs and collect latency observations
tasks.scope: Run controlled shadow and paper sessions with paired Telegram account; measure delivery and human response separately.
acceptance_criteria: Actual and assumed fills remain separate in UI and reports.
Unknown delivery is visible rather than treated as confirmed reading.
Collect received/read-response/manual-fill times only where actually observable.
Forward-run evidence includes outages, skipped alerts and user absence.
validation: Session rehearsal with disconnected bot, unavailable user and provider outage.

tasks.title: Review Telegram privacy, behavior and operational readiness
tasks.scope: Independent review of account data exposure, rate limits, failure modes and audit trace from message back to evidence.
acceptance_criteria: No message content grants authority to alter limits or broker accounts.
Sensitive account details are minimized and retention is documented.
Every action/delivery is auditable by exact recommendation revision.
Review reports remaining risks and does not enable a lane implicitly.
validation: Security/e2e suite and lost-token incident rehearsal.

tasks.title: Implement five specialist capability contracts
tasks.scope: Implement T01 order-flow/book, T02 RVOL/VWAP/profile, T03 price-action/setup, T04 breadth/rotation and T05 execution-feasibility/human-latency modules.
acceptance_criteria: Each specialist declares data granularity, venue coverage and warmup needs.
Deterministic features are computed by tested code; LLM only interprets supported outputs.
L2-specific signals remain disabled without licensed reconstructible L2.
Do not count overlap with existing liquidity/technical roles as independent votes.
validation: Capability-matrix and absent-data routing tests.

tasks.title: Build session-aware streaming features
tasks.scope: Implement bounded rolling features, same-time-of-day volume comparison, VWAP and quote/trade quality features. Only build book reconstruction when validated capabilities exist.
acceptance_criteria: Session resets, auction prints and corrections have explicit behavior.
Historical and streaming outputs pass parity tests.
Out-of-order handling and watermark policy are documented.
Compute workload does not block critical portfolio monitoring.
validation: Golden replay, burst/backpressure and late-correction tests.

tasks.title: Define human-feasible EGX/US intraday strategies
tasks.scope: Define two separate intraday strategy IDs and entry ranges long enough for measured human action. Add cooldown, max entries, no-revenge-trading and session-cutoff policies.
acceptance_criteria: No scalping or immediate execution assumption.
Same-session eligibility/cash rules are checked per account and instrument.
Unavailability and excessive delivery/user delay block fresh actionable entries.
Intraday loss cannot be relabeled as swing exposure without a separately approved policy; unexpected overnight exposure raises a review.
validation: Measured-latency sensitivity, cooldown, deadline and ineligible-security tests.

tasks.title: Validate US intraday with realistic data and costs
tasks.scope: Run US_INTRADAY holdout and forward shadow with licensed quotes/trades and actual coverage limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Include spread, fee, partial fill, human latency and halt scenarios.
Single-venue feed limitations are explicit in interpretation and eligibility.
Final-minute alerts cannot imply guaranteed session-end liquidation.
No pooled swing result substitutes for intraday evidence.
validation: Replay and forward shadow using preregistered lane thresholds.

tasks.title: Validate EGX intraday with verified eligibility
tasks.scope: Run EGX_INTRADAY holdout/shadow with approved data and effective-dated trading rules; use an explicit no-go when required market data is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Liquidity, price limits, trade status and same-session rules are modeled from verified sources.
Historical data delay and missing bid/ask cannot be hidden by OHLC approximations.
Unsupported L2 strategies remain disabled.
Release report distinguishes technical readiness from data/legal/account eligibility.
validation: Limit-state, thin-volume, missed-exit and calendar-specific fixtures.

tasks.title: Test cross-strategy arbitration and end-of-session residuals
tasks.scope: Run simultaneous swing/intraday candidates against shared account budgets and actual holdings, including unexpected carry positions. Core arbitration is tested with deterministic synthetic inputs independently of provider-specific lane evaluation.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate budget use or opposing advice for the same held quantity.
End-of-session prompts record unclosed positions rather than inventing closure.
Emergency alerts remain active while new entries are paused.
Each lane has independent approval/rollback records.
validation: Concurrent four-lane integration scenario with halted position and late manual fills.

tasks.title: Implement versioned goal definitions and permissions
tasks.scope: Define capital, base currency, target metric, horizon, deposits/withdrawals, risk caps and user availability with explicit approval and revision history.
acceptance_criteria: Target, forecast and risk budget are separate fields.
Goals cannot change risk policy or activate a strategy.
Unknown target feasibility is a valid state.
No historical example capital amount or profit rate becomes an assumed user choice.
validation: Auth, optimistic concurrency and attempted risk-escalation tests.

tasks.title: Implement feasibility and scenario analysis
tasks.scope: Evaluate goals using approved out-of-sample evidence, costs and correlated return paths; support insufficient-evidence and conflicts-with-risk outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Report assumptions and uncertainty; no model-invented success percentage.
Preserve loss clustering/cross-asset dependencies in scenario choices or disclose limitations.
Do not infer guaranteed attainability from backtest mean returns.
No recommendation to borrow or automatically increase risk.
validation: Hand-check required-return arithmetic and extreme/cost/deposit scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement conservative capital allocation proposals
tasks.scope: Propose lane budgets within current risk limits and confirmed balances; keep cash idle when suitable opportunities do not exist.
acceptance_criteria: All allocations pass the same policy kernel and account-level atomic reservation.
Goal deadlines cannot multiply loss limits or alter strategies.
Cross-currency transfers require actual recorded funding, not hypothetical available value.
Policy changes require explicit human-reviewed revisions.
validation: Aggressive-target, insufficient-cash and correlated-lane allocation tests.

tasks.title: Implement progress, drawdown and cost attribution
tasks.scope: Report realized/unrealized returns, FX contribution, trading costs, operating costs and cash flows separately; measure horizon-end attainment as well as temporary crossing.
acceptance_criteria: Deposits are not profits; withdrawals do not automatically become losses.
Actual and paper goal progress use isolated balances.
Currency source/time and stale valuation are visible.
Target attainment does not trigger a broker sell order.
validation: Cash-flow, FX, operating-cost and realized-versus-unrealized fixtures.

tasks.title: Deliver goal reviews and safe target-revision workflow
tasks.scope: Provide scheduled or event-driven goal status and proposed changes to goal/term, never automatic increases in risk.
acceptance_criteria: Every forecast links to an assessment version and expiry.
Low-feasibility messages explain no-trade or revised horizon options without guarantees.
Goal changes require authenticated explicit confirmation and append history.
No loss-chasing, averaging down or horizon switch is introduced implicitly.
validation: Telegram goal message, revision audit and unauthorized change tests.

tasks.title: Evaluate goal policy against no-goal baseline
tasks.scope: Test whether the goal layer changes risk, drawdowns, turnover and net outcomes compared with the same strategies without goals.
acceptance_criteria: Report shortfall, attainment at horizon, drawdown breaches and costs.
Maintain preregistered evaluation and avoid selecting only successful start dates.
Reject goal logic that breaches policy even when it increases returns.
Reviewer signs an evidence report without promising future performance.
validation: Historical and forward-paper goal scenarios with withheld periods.

tasks.title: Create React dashboard shell and authenticated API client
tasks.scope: Implement React/TypeScript/Vite with a generated or validated API client and server-state query management; no parallel business backend.
acceptance_criteria: Account/mode selection is explicit and protected.
Tokens are not embedded in builds or logged.
Server-side authorization remains authoritative.
Arabic-first layout handles ticker and numeric direction correctly.
validation: Type checks, auth-flow tests and responsive accessibility smoke tests.

tasks.title: Build actual portfolio, reconciliation and goal screens
tasks.scope: Show actual holdings, settled cash, pending settlement, discrepancies, capital reservations and goal progress with source times.
acceptance_criteria: PAPER and actual accounts have unmistakable mode labels.
Balances show freshness and discrepancies rather than silently assuming correctness.
Edits flow through validated APIs with audit entries.
Deposit/withdrawal and goal revision workflows preserve history.
validation: E2E tests for manual fill, reconciliation discrepancy and goal changes.

tasks.title: Build recommendation and evidence drill-down
tasks.scope: Expose recommendation revisions, committee dissent, original evidence references, data quality and deterministic veto reasons.
acceptance_criteria: An old revision is not shown as current actionable advice.
No raw model private reasoning is required; store concise supported rationale and evidence.
Access to licensed documents respects entitlements.
User can distinguish recommendation, delivery, response and actual fill.
validation: Authorization, stale revision and missing-evidence UI tests.

tasks.title: Implement operations and cost dashboards
tasks.scope: Expose feed lag, queue age, quality gates, lane modes, model cost, quota usage, unknown deliveries and reconciliation freshness.
acceptance_criteria: Operational SLOs are labeled targets until measured under defined workload.
Budget exhaustion and degraded mode appear clearly.
Circuit breaker and entry-pause controls require authorization and audit.
High-cardinality account/evidence IDs are not metric labels.
validation: Inject stale feed, queue saturation, high cost and unknown Telegram send.

tasks.title: Complete alerting and incident runbooks
tasks.scope: Define responders and runbooks for provider failure, bot compromise, DB restore, queue backlog, bad filing extraction and ledger discrepancies.
acceptance_criteria: Critical alerts have owners, severity and documented response.
Separate pause-new-entries from stop-everything behavior.
Recovery requires data/portfolio revalidation before advice resumes.
Runbooks contain no real secrets and distinguish observed facts from instructions.
validation: Tabletop incident exercise with evidence and follow-up defects.

tasks.title: Review full user journey and privacy controls
tasks.scope: Validate the end-to-end owner workflow and data access/deletion/export boundaries before production release readiness.
acceptance_criteria: No frontend/button shortcut can bypass risk or create a broker order.
Data retention and deletion reconcile audit requirements with user privacy and provider licenses.
User-visible performance describes simulation assumptions and real costs.
Independent review records issues and closure evidence.
validation: E2E, authorization, injection, privacy and API-rate-limit suites.

tasks.title: Provision approved AWS topology with least privilege
tasks.scope: Provision approved ECS application workers, RDS PostgreSQL, S3 and a durable NATS deployment or approved managed provider via Terraform.
acceptance_criteria: Environment/account/network boundaries and resource budgets are explicit.
No public database or unrestricted NATS endpoints.
NATS persistence and HA topology match the approved failure model.
Production provisioning and recurring spend require explicit owner approval.
validation: Terraform validation/plan review, least-privilege checks and private-network smoke tests.

tasks.title: Build provenance-aware CI/CD and release manifests
tasks.scope: Build immutable images with pinned dependencies, SBOM/provenance and registry digests; deploy through OIDC-scoped GitHub Actions and approval-protected environments.
acceptance_criteria: No long-lived AWS keys in CI and no deployment credentials for untrusted PRs.
A release identifies code, DB migration, contracts, models/prompts and strategy/policy configs.
Separate deploy from lane activation.
Rollback plan documents schema compatibility and does not pretend to reverse economic events.
validation: Tampered artifact, denied environment and previous-version rollout tests.

tasks.title: Validate backup restore and disaster recovery
tasks.scope: Exercise DB point-in-time restore, evidence availability, credentials recovery and NATS consumer reconstruction in a separate environment.
acceptance_criteria: Measure recovery time/data loss against approved RTO/RPO, not merely backup job success.
Reconcile ledger and outbox/inbox after restore before re-enabling advice.
Restore cannot emit historical recommendations to production Telegram.
A failure of OpenClaw is irrelevant because it is absent from core dependencies.
validation: Documented destructive exercise only in an isolated approved test environment.

tasks.title: Run workload, saturation and dependency chaos tests
tasks.scope: Test workload profiles covering feed bursts, candidate fan-out, slow LLMs, database contention and separate batch/live workloads.
acceptance_criteria: Publish p50/p95/p99 with workload definition and external provider latency separated.
Backpressure sheds/defer noncritical research before losing financial integrity.
Unknown Telegram outcomes and partial upstream outages remain visible.
No performance shortcut disables data or policy checks.
validation: Load, soak, restart, throttling and network-partition test reports.

tasks.title: Complete security, vendor and compliance release review
tasks.scope: Review dependency/vulnerability results, threat model, provider entitlements, model data terms, account eligibility and any commercial-use obligations.
acceptance_criteria: No critical unaccepted security issue or expired data entitlement remains.
Risk-policy approver, credentials owner and incident contacts are recorded.
Commercial launch remains blocked until appropriate jurisdiction-specific legal review; evidence agent is not counsel.
Read-only broker access is independently checked to exclude trading scope.
validation: Security regression, permission audit and entitlement expiration simulation.

tasks.title: Freeze production-readiness candidate
tasks.scope: Assemble technical release evidence and remaining lane-specific blockers; create an owner-reviewed release candidate with live advisory still disabled.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence references exact commit/build and is reproducible.
No sprint completion automatically flips a live flag.
Runbooks, metrics, recovery and training of the owner are complete.
Any failed mandatory gate yields NO_GO with an actionable blocker.
validation: Full release rehearsal and rollback compatibility review.

tasks.title: Assess US_SWING forward-paper evidence
tasks.scope: Review US swing forward-paper evidence against preregistered sample/coverage, costs, reliability and uncertainty criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Compare forecasts/paper execution to observed actionable opportunities and user latency.
Record GO/NO_GO and remaining uncertainty; no guaranteed profit claim.
Owner explicitly approves any LIMITED_ADVISORY transition.
Public rollout or paid users are outside private approval scope.
validation: Lane release checklist and independent evidence review.

tasks.title: Assess EGX_SWING forward-paper evidence
tasks.scope: Independently assess EGX swing with actual EGX data/eligibility/fee evidence and user execution limitations.
acceptance_criteria: US results cannot satisfy EGX thresholds.
Liquidity, limit-state and unavailable-history limitations are explicit.
Owner approves only the scoped account/lane and limits.
Failure leaves the lane disabled without blocking already approved independent lanes.
validation: EGX lane checklist and independent evidence review.

tasks.title: Assess US_INTRADAY forward-paper evidence
tasks.scope: Validate forward-paper US intraday performance and practical execution with measured human availability and latency.
acceptance_criteria: Costs and delays do not assume ideal fills.
Account-specific rules and settlement/cash capabilities are confirmed.
Intraday close/carry exceptions are demonstrated.
Activation requires independent approval; swing approval is insufficient.
validation: US intraday lane checklist, latency sensitivity and session-end drill.

tasks.title: Assess EGX_INTRADAY forward-paper evidence
tasks.scope: Validate EGX intraday eligibility, data capability and forward-paper evidence; explicitly permit a NO_GO outcome if reliable inputs do not exist.
acceptance_criteria: Required quotes/trades, timing and exchange rules are verified.
Optional L2 remains off unless separately qualified.
No claim that same-session closing is guaranteed.
Only owner-approved limited advisory can follow all gates.
validation: EGX intraday checklist, non-fill/limit scenario and independent review.

tasks.title: Operate staged advisory and outcome attribution
tasks.scope: Record per-lane GO/NO_GO outcomes, run only approved lanes with limited scope and compare actual executions to advice and paper assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: A NO_GO verdict is a valid completed review task, not an activated lane.
Live enablement requires explicit external owner authorization not just a task status.
Record skipped trades, user deviations, rejected candidates and uncertain fills.
Drift or safety breach pauses entries and triggers reviewed investigation.
Start only a lane whose own S15 review has completed with GO and whose external owner approval is recorded; no other lane is implicitly enabled.
validation: Live-advisory dry-run checklist and simulated pause/rollback of one lane.

tasks.title: Publish operating review and controlled improvement backlog
tasks.scope: Review net outcomes including data/model/infra costs, operational reliability and user fit. Propose future changes as versioned experiments rather than online self-modification.
acceptance_criteria: Separate actual realized results from hypothetical and unrealized performance.
Update task/state/handoff records with exact release evidence.
Any strategy/model/risk change returns through relevant validation gates.
Optional OpenClaw work can begin only as a separately authorized scope.
validation: Reproduce operating report and reconcile account state with available statements.

tasks.title: Approve optional integration and threat model
tasks.scope: Confirm a real user need and review the currently supported OpenClaw integration mechanism and security model before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit owner approval is recorded; optional work is not part of core release gating.
Review current official docs instead of relying on historical capability claims.
ADR-011 remains the governing decision.
validation: Threat-model review and approval record.

tasks.title: Expose narrowly scoped read-only assistant API
tasks.scope: Provide approved report/explanation endpoints with dedicated read-only identity and field-level privacy filtering.
acceptance_criteria: No DB/NATS access or write credentials.
No risk, strategy, portfolio or recommendation mutation API.
Every response carries revision/time and permission-filtered evidence references.
validation: Read-only scope, cross-account and privilege-escalation tests.

tasks.title: Implement assistant adapter and factual explanation prompts
tasks.scope: Build the minimum adapter to retrieve approved reports and explain decisions with citations, without generating official independent advice.
acceptance_criteria: No unvalidated buy/sell instruction is presented as official platform output.
Unknown or stale answers are labeled.
Provider tokens and account details remain outside prompts where unnecessary.
validation: Grounding and prompt-injection tests for returned documents.

tasks.title: Verify isolation and zero core dependency
tasks.scope: Disconnect and compromise the assistant in a controlled test; verify core analysis, official Telegram and monitoring continue.
acceptance_criteria: Core startup and release do not require assistant availability.
Read-only credentials cannot mutate state or publish events.
Assistant outage creates no trading-platform outage.
validation: Network isolation, credential-abuse and dependency-removal tests.

tasks.title: Add revocation, retention and bounded cost controls
tasks.scope: Provide credential revocation, query limits and audited access, with minimum retention and a dedicated cost ceiling.
acceptance_criteria: Single revocation disables the assistant identity without affecting core services.
Sensitive prompts/responses follow approved retention.
Assistant traffic cannot starve live workloads.
validation: Revocation, rate-limit and noisy-neighbor tests.

tasks.title: Review and release optional integration
tasks.scope: Publish a separately versioned optional integration release or document a decision not to enable it.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence proves human-only and read-only invariants.
Core remains deployable with integration removed.
Session handoff and state records distinguish optional release from core readiness.
validation: Optional release checklist and disable rehearsal.
